methodology_other: This methodology takes 5-year age group by sex and disaggregates them using Sprague multipliers to obtain single years of age by sex. It then uses starting age and duration by educational cycle to reconstruct the corresponding school age groups by level, by males, females, and total. It works entirely with rasters, so the native 100m resolution from WorldPop remains as the final data granularity.
name: spatialized-100m-school-age-population-grid-for-haiti-by-educational-level-and-sex
notes:
This GeoTIFF file contains 12 bands presenting the school age population for Haiti in 2020. It was constructed using constrained UN-adjusted spatialized age and sex population estimates for 2020 by [WorldPop](https://hub.worldpop.org/geodata/summary?id=50431 "Haiti 100m Age structures in 2020 with country total adjusted to match the corresponding UNDP estimate"), by applying the methodology published by [IIEP-UNESCO](https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000379198 "Estimating school-age populations by applying Sprague multipliers to raster data") (2021). The bands contain information for Female, Male, and Total, for Pre-primary, Primary, Lower Secondary, and Upper secondary, reconstructed from single years of age using ISCED information on starting age and duration included in [UIS](http://data.uis.unesco.org/ "UIS.Stat"). The correspondence is included below:

* Band 1: Pre-primary Female
* Band 2: Pre-primary Male
* Band 3: Pre-primary Total
* Band 4: Primary Female
* Band 5: Primary Male
* Band 6: Primary Total
* Band 7: Lower secondary Female 
* Band 8: Lower secondary Male
* Band 9: Lower secondary Total
* Band 10: Upper secondary Female
* Band 11: Upper secondary Male
* Band 12: Upper secondary Total

The boundaries used for the clipping of the resulting calculations came from the [United Nations Second Administrative Level Boundary program](https://www.unsalb.org/data/hti "Haiti").
